description: Generates a PDF of a document (invoice, quote, proforma invoice, receipt or credit note) and returns it base64-encoded in structuredContent.pdf_base64, with its verification URL and an editor_url that opens the same document in the editor. PDFs from this tool include a LuckPanda footer and a verification QR code. Side effects: stores a verification record for the PDF (issuer name, document type, date, currency and total; no client details) and a 7-day copy of the document behind editor_url. Limit: about 40 PDFs an hour per network.

doc.description: A document to prefill. Parts that fail validation are left out and listed in `ignored`; nothing is ever rendered as HTML.

buyer.description: The client (for a receipt, who paid).

country_code.description: Buyer only; the seller's country is the document's country_code.

state_code.description: India: two-digit GST state code or the state name.

tax_id.description: GSTIN (India), VAT number (UK/EU), EIN (US), ABN, TRN...

country_code.description: The seller's country: decides currency, formats and tax rules. If missing: the currency's country (INR -> IN, GBP -> GB …; EUR -> DE unless the caller is in a euro country), else the caller's country.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code. If missing: the seller country's currency.

due_date.description: Due date; for a quote, valid until.

lines.description: The items or services, 1 to 100 lines.

hsn_sac.description: India: HSN (goods, 4/6/8 digits) or SAC (services, 6 digits starting 99).

unit_price.description: Alternative: price per unit in major units ("1250.50").

unit_price_minor.description: Price per unit in minor units (cents, paise).

notes.description: Shown on the document, for example a thank-you or a delivery note.

original_invoice_number.description: Credit notes: the invoice it corrects.

place_of_supply.description: India: GST state code, or 96 for another country.

reason.description: Credit notes: refund, product_return, discount, price_correction, defect, cancellation, tax_correction, other, or the reason in your own words.

seller.description: Your business (who issues the document; for a receipt, who received the money).

country_code.description: Buyer only; the seller's country is the document's country_code.

state_code.description: India: two-digit GST state code or the state name.

tax_id.description: GSTIN (India), VAT number (UK/EU), EIN (US), ABN, TRN...

terms.description: Payment terms and bank details; for a quote, validity and delivery terms.

page.description: The page to open: a slug ("credit-note", "gst-invoice-format") or its URL. Default: the generator for the document type and country.

name: create_document_pdf

docs_url.description: Public page describing this server and its tools.

editor_url.description: Short link that opens the same document in the LuckPanda editor (7 days). Omitted when the link limit is reached.

ignored.description: Parts of the input that were left out because they were invalid, as dotted paths.

missing.description: Required fields still empty, as dotted paths (e.g. buyer.name, lines.0.description).

formatted.description: The amounts formatted for the document's country.

subtotal_minor.description: Before tax and discount, in minor units (cents, paise).

supply.description: India: the kind of supply, when it is known.

variant.description: "branded": the PDF carries the LuckPanda footer and verification QR code.

verify_url.description: Page that confirms the PDF was made by LuckPanda and shows what was printed on it.

title: Create a document PDF
